leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply createApi from RTK Query to define a new API service for data fetching.
Use baseQuery configuration to specify the base URL for API requests.
Implement endpoint definitions to create query operations for fetching data.
Execute the generated hooks to fetch and display data in React components.
Utilize TypeScript generics to type API responses and parameters for type safety.
Assign fetched data to component state using the data property from query hooks.
Access loading and error states from query hooks to handle different UI states.
Control cache behavior by implementing tag invalidation for data updates.
Define mutation endpoints to perform create, update, and delete operations.
Invoke mutation hooks to send data to the server and update the cache.
Handle automatic cache updates by configuring tag relationships between queries and mutations.
Return structured UI components that conditionally render based on loading, error, and data states.
